candidates.detail: Support::new verifies that selected triangle extrema are finite and increasing and that thigh and waist support counts are sufficient, then casts ceil((high - low) / 0.025) to u32 and adds one. Finite extrema low=0 and high=2^30 pass the extrema guard; the quotient exceeds u32::MAX, so Rust float-to-integer casting saturates to u32::MAX and the following +1 overflows. If reached with integer overflow checks enabled this operation panics; with checks disabled it wraps to zero. Neither the actual build configuration nor any panic, return, device behavior or malformed fitted mesh was observed.
candidates.input_and_path: A small conceptual body suffices: three valid indexed vertices owned wholly by L_UPLEG with y coordinates 0, 0 and 2^30; one face [0,1,2]; matching rows and a three-joint rig containing ROOT, L_UPLEG and L_LOWLEG. The same left-thigh vertices also belong to Hips, yielding thigh_end=3 and waist_end=6. Root/hip/knee y positions 1, 0.75 and 0.25 give a finite positive suspension span for a valid Tassets design with WrappedTassetDesign defaults except section_break=0. Public FitBody and Realization accept the arrays; GpuBody::new checks row lengths, rig bounds and face indices but not these coordinate magnitudes. If upload succeeds and the public fit_recipe_async path reaches the direct wrapped garment branch with no lower layers, it calls left Support::new before right support or tasset device recording. This is a constructed source argument, not an executed fixture or proof that actual producer assets contain such values.

Device section hull count guards and final shell-height checks exist, but follow this host computation and do not bound it. Follow-on unchecked-mode output or GPU behavior is not established. Public design and support guard checks remain meaningful for their admitted properties.
